decisive_items: Many histiocytes and giant cells contained intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo
Special stains (Grocott-Gomori methenamine-silver nitrate and periodic acid–Schiff) highlighted fungal forms
response.rationale: The presence of intracellular yeasts within histiocytes and the highlighting of fungal forms by special stains are highly suggestive of histoplasmosis, making it the most likely diagnosis. The runner-up, chronic granulomatous disease, is also considered due to the presence of a mixed cell infiltrate, but the specific findings of intracellular yeasts and positive special stains make histoplasmosis a more specific diagnosis.

rejected.why: Lack of specific findings for oral ulcerative lesions beyond the presence of a nonhealing ulcer
Absence of underlying induration, friability, or bleeding on manipulation makes squamous cell carcinoma less likely
